H1.level: two-sided a_H1/k per component; criterion B bounds at nominal a_pair/1.4
H1.outcome: supported if >= 1 pair meets the criterion, else 'not shown'; per pair descriptive 'reversal excluded' / 'open'

H2.quality_side: E: equal-width promoted pairs per network, TOST delta 1.0 pp, pointwise two-sided 90 % interval
H2.cost_criterion_frozen: X lower multiplier-only area and Y lower complete-MAC area (decode, scale, accumulate at certified width) at every pipeline setting, one PDK, placement-seed spread reported

H3.accumulator: uniform signed saturating register sat.w<W>, bias outside in binary64
H3.cases_mobilenet: OC8 (interim floor list: mobilenet_v2 int8/int6/fp6_e2m3/fp7_e3m3/fp8_e4m3fn, mobilenet_v3_large int8/fp7_e3m3/fp8_e4m3fn; C = 15)
H3.sequence_N: from W_noevent(1k) down; pass if lower bound > -1.0; stop at first failure; k* = narrowest of the passing run; one-sided a_case/2
H3.sequence_I: from narrowest grid width up; pass if upper bound < -1.0; stop at first failure; f = widest of the passing run; one-sided a_case/2
H3.zero_event_width: interval [0,0]; passes N without a test ('identical'); cannot pass I
H3.slack: s* = W_cert_abs - k*; also against the structural certificate and the [Agg24] closed form
H3.event_counts: 9k saturation-event count per run width, declared outcome (OC2)
H3.float_accumulators: fp16 rule, f21, control: secondary NI against wide, pointwise one-sided 95 %

M1.cases_mobilenet_rule: admitted to H3 by OC8 and projected TOST power >= 0.8: power = Phi((1-|D_s|)/se9 - z) + Phi((1+|D_s|)/se9 - z) - 1, se9 from Q1's 1k 95 % interval / (2 x 1.96 x 3), z at C_M = 8 + admitted (calibrated)
M1.criterion: TOST 1.0 pp, each side one-sided a_M1/C_M at nominal /1.4
M1.also: per-image change rate with one-sided 95 % upper bound

D.contrasts: each promoted format vs INT8 and vs FP32 (disclosed), YOLOv8n COCO 4k, recipe OC5

D.confirmatory_rule: TOST, both sides at a_D/n_D, interval form OC9
